description: Verifies an APS planning issue after the planner has executed the SyteLine steps from aps-exception-analysis: parse the new exception report, normalize it, compare against the recorded baseline snapshot, then branch. Resolved -> close the issue. Not resolved -> run one bounded re-analysis (subflow aps-exception-analysis at the live alias), then fall through to close-issue, which no-ops on resolved=false. The runner falls through after a taken branch, so close-issue is the LAST step: resolved=true jumps forward over reanalyze (marked skipped) straight to close-issue; resolved=false runs reanalyze and then falls into close-issue, which performs no state change on resolved=false (fall-through-safe by design). Loop bound: at most ONE automatic re-analysis per verify run (subflow depth 2 of the platform max 5); repeated cycles are separate runs, each fully audited.

issueId.description: Planning issue id created by the analysis run

newReportDocumentId.description: Document id of the NEW exception report uploaded after the planner executed the SyteLine steps

site.description: SyteLine site the report and the issue belong to

name: aps-exception-verify

closed.description: Whether aps.closeIssue closed the issue (false when not resolved — the tool performs no state change)

resolved.description: Whether the compare found the issue resolved

title: APS exception verification: compare new report, close or re-analyze
